title: Weather and Climate
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Social Studies; not yet checked by a CBC Social Studies teacher; not loaded by the live tutor
notes: Set up a school weather station (rain gauge from a bottle, wind vane from card) and record for two weeks. Facts: the arid north and north-east, the hot humid coast, the cool highlands, the warm wet Lake Victoria basin.

skills.key_step: The child names the elements of weather, matches each to its instrument, and tells weather (a day) from climate (many years).

floor.prerequisite: Names the seasons and their weather.
floor.question: Which season has the most rain?

steps: Name the element: temperature, rainfall, wind, humidity, cloud, sunshine.
Read today's record: that is weather.
Look at many years: that is climate.
contexts: the rain gauge in the school garden
a weather report on the radio
a farmer deciding when to plant

board.do: Write thermometer, rain gauge, wind vane.
Ask whether today's rain tells us the climate.

misconceptions.ask: Which statement is about climate and not weather?
misconceptions.repair: Ask "how long did we watch?" One day is weather. Many years is climate.

misconceptions.ask: Which instrument measures the amount of rain?
misconceptions.repair: Match each instrument to a unit: degrees, millimetres, direction.

listen_for: How fast the wind is blowing
misconceptions.ask: What does a wind vane show?
misconceptions.repair: Make a card vane and watch it turn to face the wind; then spin a cup anemometer.

misconceptions.ask: The sky is full of clouds but no rain falls. What is the weather?
misconceptions.repair: Record cloud cover and rainfall in separate columns for a week.

checks.question: Is "it rained in Kisumu this morning" weather or climate?

skills.key_step: The child places Kenya's climate regions: arid north and north-east, hot humid coast, cool highlands, warm wet Lake Victoria basin.

floor.prerequisite: Places Kenya's main features on a map.
floor.question: Where is Mount Kenya?

representations: a climate map of Kenya in four colours
steps: Find the high land: the highlands are cool.
Find the coast: hot and humid.
Find the north and north-east: hot and dry.
Find the lake basin: warm and wet.
contexts: tea in the cool Kericho highlands

board.do: Draw Kenya and split it into four zones.
Write the climate in each zone with one town.

misconceptions.ask: Which part of Kenya has an arid climate, with very little rain?
misconceptions.repair: Match three towns to rain: Nyeri (much rain), Mombasa (humid), Lodwar (very little).

listen_for: Hot and dry with very little rain
misconceptions.ask: Which description fits Mombasa on the coast?
misconceptions.repair: Hot has two kinds: dry (Lodwar) and humid (Mombasa). Ask about the sea air.

misconceptions.ask: Which climate region is Nairobi closest to?
misconceptions.repair: Compare Nairobi's cool mornings with Mombasa's warm nights on a temperature chart.

misconceptions.ask: Which climate region is around Lake Victoria?
misconceptions.repair: Show the rainfall bars for Kisumu and Lodwar side by side.

checks.question: In which climate region is Mandera?
Which region has a hot and humid climate?

skills.key_step: The child describes each region's temperature and rain and explains that high places are cooler even near the equator.

floor.question: Which region is in the north?

representations: a table of temperature and rain for four towns
a hill drawing with temperatures getting cooler up the slope
steps: Say how hot it is and how much rain falls.
Give the reason: height, the sea, the lake.
contexts: snow on Mount Kenya near the equator

board.do: Draw a mountain with a thermometer at the bottom and one at the top.

board.say: Is it warmer or cooler up here?

misconceptions.ask: Mount Kenya is on the equator. Why is it cold at the top?
misconceptions.repair: Ask: is it colder at the top of a high hill than at its foot? Then link to the mountain.

misconceptions.ask: What does it mean when the coast is humid?
misconceptions.repair: Use clothes that do not dry on a humid day.

listen_for: Nyeri is far from the sun
misconceptions.ask: Why is Nyeri cooler than Mombasa?
misconceptions.repair: Show photos of snow on Mount Kenya: the highest place is the coldest.

misconceptions.ask: How do many people in the arid north earn a living?
misconceptions.repair: Show a photo of a pastoralist family with camels in Marsabit.

checks.question: Why is the top of Mount Kenya cold although it is near the equator?
checks.answer: It is very high, and high places are cooler

checks.question: Describe the climate of the coast.
checks.answer: hot and humid with plenty of rain
